description: This PHP class 'QueryParser' is part of the AWS SDK and is responsible for parsing query (XML) responses from various AWS services such as EC2 and SQS. It extends an abstract parser and uses traits for payload parsing, handling XML parsing, and interpreting response streams.

classes.name: QueryParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling XML-based query responses from AWS services, capable of peeling wrappers and parsing response bodies into Result objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with the service description, optional XML parser, and a flag to honor result wrappers.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the response by parsing the XML body, optionally removing result wrappers, and returning a Result object.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Parses a specific member from a response stream using the XML parser.
